result.instructions: Dispatch prompt or tasks (same prompt/route fields per task, optional id); status waits up to 55s. Copy the returned Route line for provenance. Full output stays in files; output reads bounded slices. Inbox peeks; claim ids, then acknowledge after processing. Writers require an owned worktree. Resume answers input_required. detail:full expands metadata. To block on running lanes use the shell, not polling: provenant lanes --wait --all --timeout 900.

tools.description: Acknowledge a claimed delivery.
tools.name: fabric_acknowledge

tools.description: Read recent activity or entries after a cursor.
tools.name: fabric_activity

tools.description: List routes and guarantees; full includes profiles; models lists one adapter's live models; action reset clears cooldowns.

action.description: reset clears cooldowns (selector: adapter or adapter/model; omit for all); use after the user says usage is back or switches accounts.

models.description: Adapter whose live models to list (cached probe).

tools.name: fabric_adapters

tools.description: Stop a run and its provider group, or one task of a batch by its task id.
tools.name: fabric_cancel

tools.description: Run one prompt or tasks; resume or hand off a run; session names a resumable conversation. wait_seconds above 55 clamps to 55.

account.description: Claude account label from accounts.claude in telemetry configuration.

capabilities.description: Array of distinct postgres or browser values.

confidential.description: Never use a prompt-training model, fallbacks included (free models count unless their entry says they do not train); works with any selector.

council.description: Run 1-8 members from the route as one batch, families spread first; members repeat when fewer are available.

delivery_run_id.description: RUN.json run_id of the delivery this lane serves; retries inherit it

knobs.description: Per-dispatch profile overrides as NAME=VALUE strings; repeated values are forwarded to the routing owner and recorded in the attempt profile stamp.

model.description: A model name or catalogue alias (for example sonnet, sol, luna, deepseek-free, glm-free); the most predictable selector. adapter/model also works.

models.description: Ad-hoc council of adapter/model[@effort] entries; bypasses route and adapter.

rotate.description: Cycle the route's pool per project instead of taking its top model; ignored with council.

route.description: Tier pool: junior (laid-out work, cheap lenses), senior (judgement, review, delegation) or principal (critical decisions); or design or writing. adapter narrows the pool; an explicit model wins over route. Prefer naming a model (deepseek-free, glm-free, sonnet, sol) when you know what you want.
